category: debrid-style 代下 / 中转 with WebDAV

free_tier.stated: No free allowance. '最低1元起购' and the smallest pack is 5 GB for ¥7 (list ¥10).

retention.stated: 链接有效期24小时: the generated download link lives 24 hours. The fetched file's own lifetime on the server was not stated.

egress.terms: '仅按实际使用流量付费' - prepaid packs with 永久 validity, no monthly subscription. Download back for a user runs over the service's CN2 line with 断点续传.

interface_detail: '支持通过 WebDAV 协议挂载到系统' - the service mounts, so a file can be streamed instead of downloaded twice. The direct URL is also a plain HTTP(S) fetch.
tooling: WebDAV mount, browser UI, parallel multi-link submission. Same platform as the same operator's 帮你下 storefront.
chaining: The only 代下 that offers WebDAV: mount it and a media player streams from the service's copy without a second transfer.

identity_cost.detail: Purchase, no account proven. Chinese payment rails are the gate.

reliability_note: Two storefronts (wuyouxia.com family, 帮你下) sell the same traffic under different prices; the 24-hour link is the operational limit to plan around.
confidence_note: Pack prices read from the vendor page; the sale price was recovered from the struck-through list price in the same markup. The zh-TW storefront quotes the same packs in USD ($1 for 5 GB), which corroborates ¥7 at about 7.1 CNY/USD.

evidence.proved: '50+ 优质网盘 • 不限带宽 • 仅按实际流量付费'; '最低1元起购'; packs 5 GB (10→7元), 25 GB (30→20元), 120 GB (100→77元), 240 GB (200→140元), 600 GB (400→315元); '链接有效期24小时'; '支持通过 WebDAV 协议挂载'
same packs quoted in USD: '最低$0.3起購', 基本款 5.0 GB $1.00 - corroborates the CNY ladder

price_per_tb_month: CNY 525 per TB retrieved (600 GB pack)
notes: Per GB: 1.40, 0.80, 0.642, 0.583, 0.525. Page markup renders the discounted price beside the list price ('10 7元'), which is how the sale ladder was read.
binding_note: Prepaid traffic binds at any scale: ¥525/TB is the cheapest sticker found, but a 1 TiB month is still ¥525 one-off, against ¥9.93 for 迅雷 SVIP. The WebDAV mount is the feature that buys that premium.
